title: CSV Plate Filling - Upgrade for OT2
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare CSV input file
steps.instruction: Create a comma‑separated file that includes a header line. Column 1 is an identifier (ignored by the protocol). Column 2 contains the M9 media volume for each well. Columns 3 through n‑1 contain the volumes of up to 35 antibiotics (stored in 15 mL tubes on tuberack 1 and 2). Column n contains the barcoding dye volume. Example rows: "99999,50,0,0,…,0,50" and "100,90,10,0,…,0,0". Save the file for upload when the protocol starts.

steps.title: Load labware and tips
steps.instruction: Place 1–6 Nunc 96‑well plates on deck slots 1‑6 as specified by the “Number of plates” parameter. Load a tuberack on slot 8 containing three 50 mL tubes of M9 media. Load two 15 mL tuberacks (positions 1 and 2) with the antibiotic solutions. Load tip racks for 20 µL tips and 300 µL tips (brand Opentrons or BrandTech) in the designated slots. Set the “Height offset for dispensing antibiotics into target wells [mm]” parameter (offset above the calculated liquid level minus 0.4 mm).

substeps.instruction: Place plates in sequential order from slot 1 to slot 6.
Load antibiotic tubes on tuberack 1 and 2.
Load 20 µL tip rack (Opentrons or BrandTech).
Load 300 µL tip rack (Opentrons or BrandTech).
Enter height‑offset value in the protocol settings.

steps.title: Transfer M9 media
steps.instruction: Using the 20 µL pipette, dispense the volume indicated in column 2 of the CSV into each well, following the plate order (first 96 rows → plate 1, next 96 rows → plate 2, etc.).

steps.title: Transfer antibiotic mixes
steps.instruction: Using the 300 µL pipette, dispense each antibiotic volume from the corresponding CSV columns into the target wells. Apply the user‑defined height offset (calculated liquid level − 0.4 mm + offset) for each dispense to avoid touching the well bottom.

steps.title: Transfer barcoding dye
steps.instruction: Using the appropriate pipette (20 µL or 300 µL as needed), dispense the volume from the final CSV column into each well as specified.

steps.title: Replace plates and tips if needed
steps.instruction: If the CSV contains more rows than the total number of wells (plates × 96), the robot pauses and prompts the user to replace the filled plates with fresh ones and to load new tip racks. After replacement, the protocol resumes at the “Transfer M9 media” step for the remaining rows.
